how: Per component the match of the live component against the board that draws its specimen, from the COMP lane TSV (scripts/screens/component_status.py). A component without a row is not measured yet.

CnActionButtons.name: CnActionButtons
CnActionButtons.notes: same as the menu: secondary buttons blue outlined/blue text under thematiq; board neutral (grey border, dark text, dark icon)

CnActionsMenu.name: CnActionsMenu
CnActionsMenu.notes: under thematiq the secondary trigger is blue outlined with blue text and a dots icon; board: white, grey border, dark 'Meer' + chevron

CnAppNav.name: CnAppNav
CnAppNav.notes: active entry paints the link primary-light over thematiq's accent wash (board: #fcedec/#a30000); attention count text uses --color-error-text (#8A0000 under thematiq), so the number is dark red on red

CnBreadcrumbs.name: CnBreadcrumbs
CnBreadcrumbs.notes: board look draws NcBreadcrumbs' 44px button crumbs: board is a 17px text trail, link in primary regular, '/' and current crumb muted regular

CnDataTable.name: CnDataTable
CnDataTable.notes: header row grey and 64px (board white, 50px, filter funnels), rows 71px (board 66), avatar grey (board primary-light with primary initials)

CnDetailCard.name: CnDetailCard
CnDetailCard.notes: header 'Behandeling' bigger/darker and inner grid draws cards; board: 15px 600 title, compact label/value rows

CnDetailGrid.name: CnDetailGrid
CnDetailGrid.notes: board look still draws grey accent cards with label above padded value; board is plain label (13px muted) over value (15px 600) with a hairline under each pair

CnDetailPage.name: CnDetailPage
CnDetailPage.notes: header measured title + pill row only; header actions not drawn in the harness config, breadcrumb bold/dark (see CnBreadcrumbs)

CnNextStepCard.name: CnNextStepCard
CnNextStepCard.notes: title colour (board primary), done item and todo marker tones, row spacing 30 vs 28px

CnQuickFilterBar.name: CnQuickFilterBar
CnQuickFilterBar.notes: under thematiq the chips render as tab shapes and the active chip's label vanishes (dark on dark); board: 38px pills, active ink

CnStatusBadge.name: CnStatusBadge
CnStatusBadge.notes: purple pill keeps its background but the text loses its tone (dark instead of #4a3f8f) under the live theme

CnTabs.name: CnTabs
CnTabs.notes: strip drawn as outlined tabs, lower; board folder tabs: grey filled inactive, white active joined to the panel, count chips

CnTimelineStages.name: CnTimelineStages
CnTimelineStages.notes: measured through CnStagesWidget variant bars (what the board draws): todo labels dark instead of muted, dates under bars missing/clipped
